page: 2 — Reference — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: §4.45.1 Trachyspermum ammi (ajwain) cream — evidence line under the heading
sentence_as_it_stands: Magnitude MODEST · Duration 4 weeks of [dose figure omitted] application in the trials · Evidence RCT-ADJACENT (burning feet from peripheral neuropathy, n=92, placebo-cream-controlled) + CONFLICTING (null replication, n=30)
quote: Patients with unknown neuropathy 70 (Placebo/Ajwain as 36/34) … In regard of the neuropathic pain, previously established historical diagnosis as well as clinical examination such as nerve conduction studies was considered.
corrected_wording: Evidence RCT-ADJACENT (burning feet; neuropathy diabetic in 22 and of unknown cause in 70, diagnosed by history and clinical examination with no small-fibre test; n=92, placebo-cream-controlled) + CONFLICTING (null replication, n=30)
notes: The paper never calls the population peripheral neuropathy. It says 'Neuropathy types were diabetic and unknown' (p. 4), and the sample included patients with a history of stroke (21), multiple sclerosis (8), Parkinsonism or Alzheimer's (11) and radiculopathy (7) (Table 2). The 70 of unknown cause are what makes the trial relevant to idiopathic SFN, so the line should say so rather than 'peripheral neuropathy'.

page: 1 — Product Guide — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: Ranks 11 to 17 · Cheap tests of open questions (band introduction) and Rank 12 entry
sentence_as_it_stands: the ajwain cream at 12 has the single closest published trial to this reader’s symptom rather than an open question, and its raw material has to be imported — €9.02 for 10 mL from Naturitas, about €54 a month at the [dose figure omitted] a whole leg needs, before shipping and before the compounder’s fee — which is exactly why it is at 12 and not at 5.
quote: As it was considered before the intervention, excluded participants were … substituted with those with similar conditions.
corrected_wording: The ajwain cream at 12 rests on one trial built on this reader's symptom, but a weaker one than '92 randomised' suggests: 11 of the 92 analysed were replacements for dropouts, put into the dropout's arm rather than randomised; the analysis named is a paired t test of each group's change; the neuropathy was of unknown cause in 70 and diabetic in 22, with no small-fibre test; and the authors report that relief lasted only while the cream was used.
notes: Full-text facts not on the page: CONSORT shows 5 Ajwain and 6 placebo patients lost and 'Substituted', all 46/46 analysed (p. 4); 'The substitution was corresponded with the patients in respective group (Ajwain or placebo) and excluded numbers' (p. 4); the methods name only paired t tests (p. 3); sex counts sum to 93 against 92 enrolled (Table 2). None of this makes the trial negative, but the rank-12 placement leans on it being the closest trial, so it should be weighed again. Funding: university (finding on the 'Who paid' page).

page: 2 — Reference — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: §4.45.1 — 'What that is worth, and what it is not.'
sentence_as_it_stands: It is not worth an independent replication, because there has not been one; it is not worth a duration beyond four weeks, because none was measured; and it is not worth a product, because none exists.
quote: It was revealed that Ajwain cream can alleviate the pain only during administration.
corrected_wording: It is not worth an independent replication, because there has not been one; it is not worth a duration beyond four weeks, because no scores were reported after four weeks and the authors, who saw patients monthly for at least two months afterwards, say the cream relieved pain only while it was being used; and it is not worth a product, because none exists.
notes: Follow-up: 'To check the delayed undesirable effects and pain future recurrence, patients were asked to monthly refer to clinic for at least 2 months' (p. 3); 'Most of the patients requested additional cream (Ajwain) after a period of 2 months' (p. 5).

sentence_as_it_stands: Whole-leg coverage is [dose figure omitted] of cream a session and [dose figure omitted] a day, so the trial’s [dose figure omitted] schedule over both legs is roughly [dose figure omitted] of cream a month holding [dose figure omitted] of oil — [dose figure omitted] a month, imported.

page: 🧾 Who paid for the evidence behind each topical, and what that does to the ranking
section: What is still unknown — 'Who funded the ajwain trials.' (also 'What has no source', bullet 2)
sentence_as_it_stands: Who funded the ajwain trials. That candidate entered the ranking after this trace and was never traced. What would settle it: the same four checks run on every other candidate — funder, registered sponsor, patent search on the named investigators, and the printed declaration.
quote: Authors of this manuscript wish to express their thanks to Shiraz University of Medical Sciences (Project No. 5802) … Authors of this manuscript have no conflicts of interest.
corrected_wording: For the 92-patient trial, two of the four checks are answered by the paper: it was supported by Shiraz University of Medical Sciences (project 5802), with no commercial sponsor named, and it prints a declaration of no conflicts of interest. The registered sponsor (IRCT201201248815N1) and a patent search on the investigators remain unchecked, as does all of it for the taxane pilot.
notes: Partly answered: funder and printed declaration only.

page: Trachyspermum ammi (ajwain) seed essential oil [dose figure omitted] in a neutral cream base, compounded (Mexico)
section: Why For Purpose (property); the same text is in the body under Checklist
sentence_as_it_stands: The trial cream was standardised to thymol [dose figure omitted], about [dose figure omitted], not [dose figure omitted]; mild local skin reactions occurred.
quote: No adverse or undesirable effects were reported by patients receiving either Ajwain or placebo.
corrected_wording: The 92-patient trial's cream was standardised on its thymol content, which is not the oil percentage; that trial reported no adverse effects in either arm, while the taxane pilot reported mild erythema and itching.
notes: The thymol standardisation is from Petramfar (p. 2); the skin reactions are from the taxane pilot (Reference S253). Joined in one sentence, they read as if the 92-patient trial reported skin reactions.

page: Pain biology, ion channels, and topical anesthetics for small fiber neuropathy
section: 10.1.2 No topical treatment has a positive randomised result in this condition (also 12.1.1)
sentence_as_it_stands: Two randomised trials have been run in populations close enough to count and both are unfavourable.
quote: Patients with unknown neuropathy 70 (Placebo/Ajwain as 36/34) … Ajwain group showed significant reduction in feet burning compared to the placebo and considering the baseline or pretreatment data (P < 0.001).
corrected_wording: Two randomised trials have been run in populations close enough to count and both are unfavourable. A third, of a topical Ajwain cream in 92 patients enrolled on burning feet, 70 of them with neuropathy of unknown cause, reported a positive result on burning, but no small-fibre test was done and no result was given by cause.
notes: 12.1.1 has the parallel sentence ('The two trials run in adjacent populations … were both unfavourable'). The page never mentions the Ajwain trial, although the Guide ranks it at 12. Whether it is 'close enough to count' is the page's judgement; the full text supplies the facts (aetiology, work-up, substitutions).

page: 1 — Product Guide — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: Rank 7 · The treatment whose best-moving endpoint is burning (heading, intro and entry 7); also the Nitrates section and 'Rate burning on its own line'
sentence_as_it_stands: The only treatment anywhere in this guide whose best-moving endpoint is burning, which is the cardinal symptom here — and the trial that produced it is twenty-two patients in a crossover, with three subsequent randomised placebo-controlled trials behind it, all larger and all positive.
quote: Primary outcome was the reduction in feet burning based on visual analog scale (VAS-PI) on a 0–10 cm scale … Ajwain group showed significant reduction in feet burning compared to the placebo and considering the baseline or pretreatment data (P < 0.001).
corrected_wording: One of two treatments in this guide whose best-moving endpoint is burning: the nitrate, on four randomised placebo-controlled trials, and the ajwain cream at rank 12, on one randomised trial with burning as its primary endpoint.
notes: Table 3 (p. 5): mean change Ajwain against placebo was burning 3.55 vs 0.76, tingling 1.69 vs 0.16, allodynia 0.64 vs 0.06, numbness 0.58 vs 0.11 (VAS cm), so burning moved most and was the primary endpoint. The rank-7 heading ('The treatment whose best-moving endpoint is burning') and the Nitrates section ('topical diclofenac at rank 16 is the only other topical here with a positive burning-specific result at a conventional threshold') carry the same uniqueness claim. The Guide's own Nigella sativa entry also reports a burning result at p=0.001, not checked here.

page: 2 — Reference — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: §4.24.3 · Why it is unusually relevant (also the 'Four consequences' paragraph after the burning table)
sentence_as_it_stands: It is one of only two topicals in this reference with a positive burning-specific result, and the only one whose best-moving endpoint is that symptom; the other is topical diclofenac (§4.27.1).
quote: Primary outcome was the reduction in feet burning based on visual analog scale (VAS-PI) on a 0–10 cm scale … Ajwain group showed significant reduction in feet burning compared to the placebo and considering the baseline or pretreatment data (P < 0.001).
corrected_wording: It is one of at least three topicals in this reference with a positive burning-specific randomised result, with topical diclofenac (§4.27.1) and the ajwain cream (§4.45.1), and one of two whose best-moving endpoint is that symptom; the ajwain trial made burning its primary endpoint.
notes: The 'Four consequences' paragraph says the same: 'The nitrate is the only agent whose best-moving endpoint is the symptom that dominates this presentation, and topical diclofenac is the only other topical with a positive burning-specific result at a conventional threshold.' The Reference's own §4.45.2 also reports a burning-specific result for topical Nigella sativa (p=0.001), not checked here.

page: L-Carnitine
section: The recommendation
sentence_as_it_stands: Only one study ever measured small fibres, and it was null.
quote: Highly significant increases occurred in both epidermal (mean 100%; P = 0.006) and dermal (mean 133%; P < 0.0001) innervation after 6 months of ALCAR treatment
corrected_wording: Only one study ever counted intraepidermal small fibres, and it was null; one other, also uncontrolled and at the same daily dose, measured small sensory fibres by immunostaining area and reported increases (Hart 2004).
notes: The page's own Hart 2004 section and source entry describe that study's small-sensory-fibre (CGRP) result, so the sentence contradicts the page itself. The page's description property says it correctly ('The only study to measure intraepidermal nerve fibre density … found no change').

page: L-Carnitine
section: The one study that measured small fibres (Hart paragraph); also the Sources entry for Hart 2004
sentence_as_it_stands: Neuropathic grade improved in 76% of patients.
quote: Clinical grade of neuropathic pain improved in 15 of 21 patients overall … The neuropathic grade of five patients was unaffected by treatment, and one patient progressed from grade 1 to 2.
corrected_wording: The clinical grade, set by analgesic requirement rather than a pain score, improved in 15 of 21 patients (71%), was unchanged in 5 and worsened in 1; the abstract's 76% does not match the paper's own counts.
notes: The Sources entry repeats the abstract: 'neuropathic grade improved in 76% and was unchanged in 19%'. Grade definition (p. 2): 0 asymptomatic, 1 no analgesia, 2 non-opioid analgesics, 3 opioids, 4 pain uncontrolled by opioids. No statistical test of the grade change is reported.

page: L-Carnitine
section: The recommendation; What happened to pain, and at which dose (same sentence also in the Description property)
sentence_as_it_stands: No trial has given a structural endpoint and a pain endpoint the same dose and had both work
quote: Clinical grade of neuropathic pain improved in 15 of 21 patients overall
corrected_wording: No controlled trial has given a structural endpoint and a pain endpoint the same dose and had both work; in one uncontrolled 21-patient HIV cohort at 3,000 mg/day, small-fibre immunostaining rose and an analgesic-requirement grade improved in 15 of 21 (Hart 2004).
notes: Same sentence as tested claim A022 on 'Alternative Treatments For Growing Back Nerves In SFN'; see the A022 update. The NOW Foods page carries it too ('No trial has shown both at the same dose').

page: ALCAR (Acetyl-L-carnitine) — Dose, Form and Timing
section: Dose Range (property); also the 2026-09-24 Evidence revision ('the one skin-biopsy study … found no change')
sentence_as_it_stands: 3,000 mg/day showed no significant morphometric difference and, in the one skin-biopsy study, no change in intraepidermal fibre density. No human study has shown small-fibre regrowth at any dose.
quote: Highly significant increases occurred in both epidermal (mean 100%; P = 0.006) and dermal (mean 133%; P < 0.0001) innervation after 6 months of ALCAR treatment
corrected_wording: 3,000 mg/day showed no significant morphometric difference. Two skin-biopsy studies exist, both uncontrolled HIV-neuropathy cohorts at 3,000 mg/day: one counted intraepidermal fibres and found no change (Valcour 2009); the other measured immunostaining area and reported increases in epidermal and dermal small sensory fibres (Hart 2004). No controlled human study has shown small-fibre regrowth at any dose.
notes: Hart 2004 is an open cohort (n=21, 16 re-biopsied at six months), the same design class as Valcour's open-label pilot. Its result cannot establish regrowth without a control arm, but it is a second skin-biopsy study, and a positive one.

page: NOW Foods Acetyl-L-Carnitine 500 mg (200 capsules)
section: Checklist item 10 (also Why, Why For Purpose, Verdict and Comparison)
sentence_as_it_stands: Small fibre neuropathy is measured by intraepidermal nerve fibre density on skin biopsy, corneal confocal microscopy or sudomotor testing, and the only acetyl-L-carnitine study with a skin biopsy found no change at the distal leg (P = 0.98).
quote: Highly significant increases occurred in both epidermal (mean 100%; P = 0.006) and dermal (mean 133%; P < 0.0001) innervation after 6 months of ALCAR treatment
corrected_wording: Small fibre neuropathy is measured by intraepidermal nerve fibre density on skin biopsy, corneal confocal microscopy or sudomotor testing. Of the two acetyl-L-carnitine studies with skin biopsies, both uncontrolled at 3,000 mg/day, the one that counted intraepidermal fibres found no change at the distal leg (P = 0.98), and the other reported increased small-fibre immunostaining area (Hart 2004).
notes: The same 'one/only skin-biopsy study' wording is in Why ('its one skin-biopsy study, open-label, was null'), Why For Purpose, the Verdict and the Comparison ('its only skin-biopsy study was null'). Why For Purpose also says '2,000–3,000 mg/day buys the pain signal and forgoes the structural one'; the only positive skin result, Hart's uncontrolled one, was at 3,000 mg/day.

page: 2 — Reference — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: §6.12.2 · Acetyl-L-carnitine — real randomised regeneration evidence, about myelinated fibres
sentence_as_it_stands: Every regeneration claim for this molecule rests on sural nerve morphometry, which counts myelinated axons in a nerve trunk; the one skin-biopsy dataset is this one, and it is negative.
quote: Highly significant increases occurred in both epidermal (mean 100%; P = 0.006) and dermal (mean 133%; P < 0.0001) innervation after 6 months of ALCAR treatment
corrected_wording: Every controlled regeneration claim for this molecule rests on sural nerve morphometry, which counts myelinated axons in a nerve trunk. There are two skin-biopsy datasets, both uncontrolled HIV cohorts at 3,000 mg/day: this one, which counted intraepidermal fibres and is negative, and Hart 2004, which measured immunostaining area and reported small-fibre increases.
notes: Hart 2004 (PMID 15238773) is not in the Reference's source register. The sentence before it ('this is the only place in the whole acetyl-L-carnitine literature where [intraepidermal nerve fibre density] was applied to this drug') is correct, since Hart measured area, not fibre density.

page: 2 — Reference — Topical Treatments for Small Fiber Neuropathy
section: Source register, S450
sentence_as_it_stands: S450. The only skin biopsy ever taken in an acetyl-L-carnitine trial.
quote: After the baseline biopsy, 11 patients had one further biopsy, 10 had two and 1 had three.
corrected_wording: S450. The only intraepidermal nerve fibre count in an acetyl-L-carnitine study; the only other skin biopsies, in an uncontrolled cohort, were scored by immunostaining area (Hart 2004).
notes: Valcour 2009 is itself an open-label single-arm pilot, the same design class as Hart's open cohort, so 'trial' does not separate the two.

sentence_as_it_stands: Burakgazi 2020 studied eight subjects with previously diagnosed small fibre neuropathy, with punch biopsies before electrical nerve stimulation therapy and at 30 and 60 days
quote: Both male and female subjects between 18 and 70 years of age with a diagnosis of idiopathic SFN were included in this study. … ENS therapy for this study was delivered to 1 leg using an AvivaStim XP stimulator, with the contralateral leg serving as an untreated control.
corrected_wording: Burakgazi 2020 studied eight subjects with idiopathic small fibre neuropathy, stimulating the calf muscles of one leg for 60 days with the other leg as an untreated control (no sham, leg chosen by the subject), with punch biopsies of both legs at baseline, 30 and 60 days
